about: When Social Security and SSI payments are due, and when to report one missing.

rows.plain: Social Security payments are paid on a Wednesday chosen by the birth date of the worker whose record you are paid on (your own, if it is your own benefit): the 1st to 10th get the second Wednesday, the 11th to 20th the third Wednesday, and the 21st to 31st the fourth Wednesday.
If you got Social Security before May 1997, or you get both Social Security and SSI, your Social Security payment is due on the 3rd of the month.
SSI is paid on the 1st of the month. When a payment day falls on a weekend or federal holiday, it is paid on the business day before.
Payments are sometimes delayed. Social Security asks you to contact it if the payment has not arrived by the third mail delivery day after the payment date.
Your my Social Security account shows your benefit and payment information and your benefit letter.
